description:
Start a pipeline run (NON-BLOCKING). Returns executionId — poll with
execution.get() until status is completed/failed, then execution.results().

description.description: Optional longer description of the experiment.

layout.description:
Optional canvas positions {nodes: {id: {x, y}}}; a deterministic
grid is synthesized when omitted.

name.description: Display name for the run (shown in the Runs list).

subject.description: Optional dataset subject code (e.g. "S01") recorded with the run.

train_graph.description:
Pipeline graph {nodes: [{id, type, config}], connections:
[{from, to}]} as built by catalog.template/pipeline.validate.

name: execution.run
title: Execution.Run
